name: run_id
description: Pipeline run id; joins to dlq.run_id.

name: reference_digest
description: SHA-256 of the canonical reference sample (provenance).

name: reference_table
description: Source table the reference rows were SELECTed from.

name: landing_table
description: Destination table for valid synthetic rows.

name: engine
description: b1_rag | b2_library.

name: model_uri
description: gs:// URI of the LLM weights used.

name: env
description: dev | uat | prd — threshold tier applied.

name: num_rows_requested
description: Rows the run was asked to generate.

name: valid_count
description: Rows that passed all Mode-A checks and landed.

name: dlq_count
description: Total dead-lettered records.

name: blocker_count
description: DLQ records whose rule_id is BLOCKER-severity.

name: dlq_by_rule
description: JSON map rule_id -> count (PARSE_JSON to query).

name: blocker_failure_ratio
description: Configured gate for this env (from thresholds.yml).

name: observed_blocker_ratio
description: blocker_count / the rows generated — valid_count + dlq_count, minus the DLQ counts of any excluded_blocker_rules (ADR 0038: an excluded rule leaves BOTH sides of the ratio).

name: status
description: PASSED | FAILED_BLOCKER.

name: excluded_blocker_rules
description: ADR 0038 — rule_ids left out of blocker_count (comma-separated); pk.duplicate on a table whose declared pk: the source disproved.

name: source_repeat_share
description: ADR 0038 — share of the SOURCE child's rows repeating a key value (1 - key_values/children over the fan-out histogram).

name: landing_repeat_share
description: ADR 0038 — pk.duplicate over the rows generated (valid_count + row.duplicate); the landing table's key-repeat share.

name: repeat_share_delta
description: ADR 0038 — landing_repeat_share - source_repeat_share.

name: repeat_share_within_tolerance
description: ADR 0038 — |repeat_share_delta| <= guardrails.repeat_share_tolerance (default 0.05); NULL when the launch measured no source share for this table.

name: created_at
description: Row write time (UTC); DAY partition key.

name: job_id
description: ADR 0044 — the Dataflow job id, read by a worker from the GCE metadata server; NULL on the DirectRunner or when the attribute is absent (readers then match job_name inside the job's window; a Composer job name is the same for every launch of a model, so the evaluator keeps the launch whose launched_at is the latest at or before the job's end).

name: job_name
description: ADR 0044 — the Dataflow job name the launcher resolved (a template launch's jobName, else sdfb-<run_id>); NULL on the DirectRunner.

name: launch_run_id
description: ADR 0044 — the launch's base run id, shared by every table of the launch (run_id is the base, or <base>-NN-<table>).

name: generator_version
description: ADR 0044 — the worker's generator version, <base>-<branch>-<sha7>[-dirty] (sdfb_core.version); the launcher's is config.launcher.version.

name: launched_at
description: ADR 0044 — launcher clock when the job's graph was built, just before it ran; created_at stays the row write time.

name: embedder_uri
description: ADR 0044 — rag.embedder_uri; empty means the HashingEmbedder.

name: retrieval_method
description: ADR 0044 — free_text.pool_seed_strategy for b1_rag; NULL for b2_library.

name: similarity
description: ADR 0044 — generation.similarity.

name: seed
description: ADR 0044 — generation.seed; derived when none was given.

name: source_stats
description: ADR 0044 — sampling.source_stats, the stats tier (off, sample or exact).

name: relationships_uri
description: ADR 0044 — relational.relationships_uri as resolved; the model itself is embedded in config.

name: relationships_digest
description: ADR 0044 — sha12 of every loaded relationship model (the relationships_loaded milestone's sha); NULL when no model was loaded.

name: config_digest
description: ADR 0044 — sha12 of config.values as canonical JSON, launch identity excluded: same digest, same generator config.

name: config
description: ADR 0044 — JSON text of the generation snapshot: config_version, values (a valid --config_uri file), provenance, overridden, derived (cache_keys), thresholds, relationships, beam, launcher, batch. PARSE_JSON or JSON_VALUE to query.
